controls: baseline native step on exact G22 without new data
native step after every accepted or rejected packet
goal and genome changes checked against exact parent
separate-process semantic replay of full result journal

goal_acceptance.evidence: at least three distinct observed instances from at least two fresh source URLs; repeated copies are not independent evidence
requires: native ranking and selection of the repeated deficit
verifiable goal with inputs, expected property, strict success threshold and utility
references to new source identities or hashes

ingress: existing Kernel.study, four mixed-source packets followed by Kernel.step
limits: bounded excerpts, not whole documents or all of the internet
retrieval is fresh; source records may describe historical periods
source selection and transport are operator-supplied
stored knowledge is not evidence of semantic understanding

packetization.excerpt: first 1500 Unicode characters of decoded original response, no field selection or transformation
packetization.metadata: source ID, URL, format, raw SHA-256 and observed retrieval time; no questions, objectives or evaluative labels
packetization.width_reason: existing knowledge envelope requires a word-width field; it supplies no task, oracle or data interpretation

stop: four fixed packets or first GOAL_FROZEN; no candidate generation or hidden answers in this experiment

transport.source_selection: operator-selected broad primary public APIs, fixed before fetch; no content-dependent substitutions
